_doc: Sprint 8 effect-extraction receipts. Each strict A-core record gets one receipt. Pooling reads only receipts that pass validate_extraction(); the rest are documented extraction failures.

receipts.failure_reason: extraction error after 2 attempts: Expecting ',' delimiter: line 12 column 34 (char 300)

evidence_quotes: Survival analysis applied to all treated cohorts, and lifespan extension by rapamycin was demonstrated relative to corresponding vehicle controls (Figure 1), confirming previously reported longevity effects.
Survival curves were calculated for rapamycin- and vehicle-treated mice (all cohorts; n = 68 per group).
receipts.failure_reason: The paper reports lifespan extension but does not provide numeric values for treated and control median lifespans.

evidence_quotes: survival of both males and females was modestly enhanced in YF animals [35].
Although survival was increased in both sexes [35]
receipts.failure_reason: The paper does not report numeric effect sizes for survival or lifespan; it only references enhancement from another study without providing median survival, hazard ratios, or other quantifiable data.
